button.drift: invisible coarse-pointer hit area and aria-disabled styling for disabled links (ux-guidelines.md#reach-and-touch-targets)

checkbox.drift: coarse-pointer hit area 48px wide and 40px tall, so 44px rows never overlap (ux-guidelines.md#shared-component-patterns)

input.drift: app-owned SearchField beside the stock Input (ux-guidelines.md#shared-component-patterns)

item.drift: bordered variant on ItemGroup for flush bordered row lists (ux-guidelines.md#shared-component-patterns)

native-select.drift: text-base below md like stock Input, so iOS does not zoom on focus (ux-guidelines.md#breakpoints)

page.reason: page anatomy modeled on dashboard-01 and sidebar-10/15 (ux-guidelines.md#shared-component-patterns)

radio-group.drift: a coarse-pointer hit area on the item (taller only in horizontal groups), and aria-labelledby pointing at its labels because axe-core skips label text inside a role=group Field (ux-guidelines.md#shared-component-patterns)

sheet.drift: motion duration tokens and reduced-motion override (ux-guidelines.md#motion); app-owned RoutedSheet so Android back closes it (ux-guidelines.md#back-gesture-and-navigation)

shell.reason: app shell modeled on sidebar-15 with phone gesture panes (ux-guidelines.md#breakpoints)

spinner.drift: forwards icon color props only when set so the icon keeps currentColor (ux-guidelines.md#tokens); decorative prop and reduced-motion stop (ux-guidelines.md#shared-component-patterns)

tabs.drift: swipe pager beside the stock parts; index re-exports raw bits-ui parts under the stock names (ux-guidelines.md#tabs-swipes-and-scroll-ownership)
